confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors are rough averages from aggregator city-cost sites, some of which are AI- or crowd-sourced or dated (one Numbeo-based figure is from June 2025). Cocktail and wine anchors are derived from the local bar-to-beer price relationship because no reliable Suzhou cocktail or wine prices were found. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates, not checked against live listings. The FX observation could not be confirmed as the latest RBA publication: the RBA overview page snippet shows 0.7088 for 20 March 2026, while a third-party copy of RBA data reports a later figure that could not be checked against rba.gov.au.
comparable_city_reasoning: Treated as a mid-sized Chinese city in the Yangtze River Delta with price levels between tier-2 and tier-1 Chinese cities. Restaurant and coffee anchors are based on Suzhou-specific aggregator figures converted at about 7.1 CNY per USD. Bar and wine anchors use a bar-beer multiplier, and accommodation anchors are general model estimates for Suzhou.
